setup: ALTER TABLE users ALTER user_id TYPE DECIMAL(38, 0)
ALTER TABLE orders ALTER user_id TYPE DECIMAL(38, 6)
input.pql: PREDICT SUM(orders.price, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.user_id

why: One key value at two scales, NUMBER(38,0) 1 in the primary key and NUMBER(38,6) 1.000000 in the foreign key: B4's decimals of different scales. Unsampled: the old client asks SAMPLE ROW for at least 1,000 rows (max_pq_iterations 10 times a context of at least 100, RE/rfm.py:2303), and every table here is smaller, so the draw is the whole table
